title: Ref2VA continuation end-state authority
description: A native metadata-only continuation-source fixture that distinguishes previous-video end state from identity-picture provenance.
humanReview: Does the prompt continue from Video 1's end state rather than reset to the identity picture's pose?
Are the established orientation, right-hand placement, hallway, and outgoing camera state preserved at the continuation boundary?
Is Picture 1 used as identity evidence rather than starting-frame authority?
Does Subject 1 remain recognizable while acting from the previous-video state?
Does the video reference retain state authority distinct from the identity reference?
